booking.referralNote: This clinic requires a referral (výmenný lístok) from your GP.
booking.gdprConsent: I consent to the processing of personal data for the purposes of healthcare provision (Art. 9 GDPR).
booking.referralConsent: I confirm that I hold a valid referral.
booking.successBody: Your booking has been successfully registered. Booking ID:
booking.cancelInfo: You can cancel via the link in the confirmation SMS.
booking.noSlots: No available slots on this day.
booking.closedNote: This clinic does not currently accept online bookings.
booking.telehealthConsentLabel: I consent to the record of the video consultation being added to my medical file in accordance with §18 of Act No. 576/2004 Coll.
booking.deviceCheckDenied: Please allow camera access for the video consultation
booking.minorBlockTitle: Telehealth is not available for patients under 16
booking.minorBlockBody: Video consultations for patients under 16 are not available online. Please contact the clinic directly.
booking.minorGuardianLabel: I confirm that a legal guardian will be present during the video consultation (for patients aged 16–17).
booking.joinActiveIn: Link will be active 10 minutes before your appointment
booking.telehealthNotEnabled: This clinic does not support video consultations.

telehealth.step1Body: Choose a clinic, date and time. Complete the health questionnaire.
telehealth.step2Body: Before the consultation, verify that your camera and microphone work correctly.
telehealth.step3Body: Click the link 10 minutes before your appointment. The physician will admit you.
telehealth.step4Body: After the consultation you will receive a summary. Prescriptions are sent via eZdravie.
telehealth.legalNote: A video consultation is a full medical consultation. All records form part of your medical file under Act No. 576/2004 Coll. Video calls are not recorded (Art. 20 GDPR).
telehealth.ctaBody: Book online in just a few minutes.

onboarding.successBody: Your registration application has been submitted. You will be notified of acceptance or rejection.
onboarding.notAccepting: This physician is not currently accepting new patients.

room.waitingBody: The physician will admit you to the consultation room shortly.
room.postcallBody: Thank you for using Telehealth. Your consultation summary is below.
room.endCallBody: This will end the video call with your physician.

error.cancelledBody: Your consultation has been cancelled. Please contact the clinic or book a new appointment.
error.no_showBody: The consultation was marked as no-show. Please contact the clinic.
error.device_deniedBody: Please allow camera and microphone access in your browser settings and try again.
error.networkBody: Could not connect to the video consultation. Please check your internet connection.
error.genericBody: An unexpected error occurred. Please contact the clinic.
